verdict.rationale: Neon's docs explicitly document Scale to Zero for idle compute (neon-docs-9/27) alongside branching/storage durability, autoscaling, and a free tier with no credit card and no time limits (neon-docs-24), directly matching the founder/prototype cost story; community evidence corroborates pay-per-use economics being a 'game-changer' for hobby projects (neon-comm-1) and fast provisioning (neon-comm-6). Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of zero idle cost specifically (vs. general community sentiment) and no explicit mention of storage durability guarantees during scale-to-zero beyond the docs claim.
